_meta.description: Model 3 – 'Catch the AI' packs. Each pack is a short piece of work an AI assistant 'wrote', with planted mistakes. The user flags the lines they think are wrong; because we planted the mistakes, scoring is exact and needs no AI. All content is invented for the demo.
_meta.pick_pack: Chosen from the user's goal-role sector (see sector_to_pack).
_meta.error_types: calculation = wrong maths; inconsistency = numbers that don't add up; fabrication = invented source/fact said with confidence; safety = a dangerous or non-compliant instruction; logic = a wrong technical claim

business.title: Q3 sales summary
business.context: Your AI assistant drafted this summary. Your manager needs it in 10 minutes.

lines.text: Total sales in Q3 were RM 120,000, up from RM 100,000 in Q2.
This is a 25% increase quarter on quarter.
The North region contributed RM 50,000 and the South region RM 60,000 of the Q3 total.

error.why: 50,000 + 60,000 = 110,000, but the total was 120,000. A region is missing or a number is wrong.

lines.text: Customer complaints fell from 30 cases in Q2 to 18 cases in Q3.
According to the Malaysian Retail Growth Index 2025, retail sales grew 40% nationally this year.

error.why: This index does not exist. AI tools often invent official-sounding sources and numbers.

lines.text: The average order value stayed at about RM 250.
We recommend hiring two more sales staff for Q4.

engineering.title: Site note: new 3 kW water pump
engineering.context: Your AI assistant drafted this note for the site team. The contractor starts work tomorrow morning.

lines.text: The new pump motor is rated 3 kW on a 230 V single-phase supply.
Full-load current is about 3 kW / 230 V = 1.3 A.

error.why: 3,000 W / 230 V is about 13 A, not 1.3 A. A cable sized for 1.3 A would overheat.

lines.text: We will use 2.5 mm² copper cable on a 20 A circuit breaker.
The motor will be installed outdoors next to the water tank.
Standard indoor sockets and switches are fine for this location.

error.why: Outdoor equipment next to water needs weatherproof (IP-rated) fittings and RCD protection.

lines.text: Work can start while the circuit is still live to save time.

error.why: Electrical work must be done with the circuit isolated and locked off. This instruction could kill someone.

lines.text: Test the earth connection and record the readings before handing over.

it.title: Login code review
it.context: Your AI coding assistant wrote this login feature and its notes. It ships to users today.

lines.text: The login form sends the user's email and password to the /api/login endpoint over HTTPS.
Passwords are stored in the database in plain text so support staff can read them out to users.

error.why: Passwords must be hashed (e.g. bcrypt or argon2) and never readable, even by staff.

lines.text: The query is built as "SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = '" + email + "'".

error.why: Joining user input into SQL allows SQL injection. Use a parameterised query.

lines.text: After 5 failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes.
The Python function hashlib.secure_hash() makes passwords impossible to crack.

error.why: hashlib has no secure_hash() function, and no hash makes passwords 'impossible' to crack. The AI invented it.

lines.text: Session tokens expire after 30 minutes of inactivity.
All login attempts are written to the security log.

actions.question: You've finished checking. What do you do now?

options.text: Send it as it is. The AI is usually right.
Fix what I found and send it without mentioning anything.
Tell my manager it isn't ready and ask for more time.
Fix what I found, tell my manager what was wrong, and say that AI drafted it.
